title: Mike Grell
description: Slave girl Leia in that wonderful little costume. Illustrator Mike Grell, who wanted to be an architect, broke into comics "with a crowbar and a little nitro." He has since become an active writer as well as an artist. Creations include WARLORD (DC), STARSLAYER (Pacific/First), JON SABLE, FREELANCE (First), SHADO (DC) and SHAMAN'S TEARS (Image). Grell has also worked on a number of projects involving classic characters, such as the TARZAN and BRENDA STARR comic strips assisting creator Dale Messick and the JAMES BOND graphic novel series from Eclipse.
